---
title: "Problems I'm Exploring"
---

Real problems I experience that are worth solving.

---

## 1. Finding the Right Guitar Tabs

Learning guitar means finding tabs that match my skill level and taste. Most tabs are either too simple or too complex. For lesser-known songs, they often don't exist.

**Why it matters** — I want to expand beyond mainstream hits. The gap between "this song exists" and "I can learn it" is too wide.

**Solution** — An AI app that listens to any song and generates tabs calibrated to your skill level.

---

## 2. Smarter Study Breaks

Productivity advice says take regular breaks, but optimal timing varies. Sometimes I'm in flow; other times I've been stuck for an hour without realizing it.

**Why it matters** — Generic "break every 25 minutes" rules don't account for how learning actually works.

**Solution** — An app that monitors engagement signals and suggests breaks when you actually need them.

---

## 3. Never Forgetting Gift Ideas

Throughout the year I notice perfect gifts for people. By birthdays and holidays, those insights are gone.

**Why it matters** — Gift-giving is about showing you pay attention. The information exists—I just can't retrieve it when needed.

**Solution** — A simple app to log gift ideas as they occur. "John likes Xbox" becomes a curated list with links.

---

## 4. Unified Rewards Tracking

Ten different restaurant apps, each with their own points systems and expiration policies. Points expire. Deals come and go. The mental overhead means I often just pay full price.

**Why it matters** — As a student, every dollar matters. These programs should save money, not add burden.

**Solution** — A unified dashboard tracking all loyalty accounts with expiration alerts and optimal redemption suggestions.

---

## 5. AI-Powered Outfit Planning

Wake up, check calendar, realize I have an important meeting, spend precious minutes figuring out what to wear.

**Why it matters** — First impressions matter. Outfit planning consumes mental energy better spent elsewhere.

**Solution** — Photograph your closet once. Each morning get outfit suggestions based on calendar events and weather.
